title: tc-sandbox-log
description:
Command output from an agent's sandbox: a collapsible block per step with the command, exit code, duration and
the output in colour; search and copy; windowed for long logs.

heading.description: Names the region, shown at the top

environment.description: Small text next to the heading – the machine, image or working directory

steps.description: The commands in the order they ran – one collapsible block each, with their output so far

open.description: Ids of the open steps – unset opens the steps that are running or failed

maxHeight.description: Height in px at which a step's output scrolls

follow.description: Keeps a step's output scrolled to its end, as a terminal does, until the reader scrolls up

hideSummary.description: Hides the summary line under the log

label.description: A plain-language line next to the command – "Run the test suite"

output.description: Everything the command printed so far, with ANSI escape codes; pass a longer string as it streams

duration.description: In ms – shown once known (update it while running for a live time)

status.description: Overrides the status the exit code gives: "queued" before it starts
